key.name: dev-widgets
key.summary: Tabs shown in the Dev preset, in order

key.name: life-widgets
key.summary: Tabs shown in the Life preset, in order

key.name: lyrics
key.summary: Show the current synced lyric line from a matching .lrc file in the pill

key.name: preferred-player
key.summary: MPRIS name (after org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.) preferred when several players are playing

key.name: gpu-pci
key.summary: PCI address of the GPU shown in Stats, like 0000:03:00.0; empty picks the one with the most VRAM

key.name: motion-speed
key.summary: Motion speed in percent; higher is snappier

key.name: motion-bounce
key.summary: Bounce of the opening morph in percent; hover and close never bounce

key.name: font-family
key.summary: Font family for the island and top bar; empty uses the system font
